input:
CURRENT SCENE:
他们住才一月就又搬家。古代的时候，一般人不喜欢卖东西的人。但是孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿，害得妈妈着急得很，因为她恐怕儿子会成为跟他们很像。她告诉了孟子：他们不是朋友，而是不好的人。

ITEMS:

[I57] 他们住才【^】一月就又搬家   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: completed duration needs 了 after 住.
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 以后每年[+都]搬家 — her note: 后来每年都搬家
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以

[I58] 他们住才一月就又搬家【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: the completed move needs sentence-final 了.
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction: 他们[去了→搬到了]一个房子

[I59] 【古代的时候】   correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train)
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]

[I60] 但是孟子【老是】跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿   correction: 老是 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 老是 and 常常 are redundant together.
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: [-孟子老是]想玩玩
  her past correction: ⟦所以⟧孟子常常玩玩 — her note: “所以” is not appropriate, since here is not a cause-effect relationship
  her past correction: 孟子从早到晚[+都]想玩玩儿

[I61] 因为她【恐怕】儿子会成为跟他们很像   correction: 恐怕 → 担心   strength: error
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 孟母[恐怕→怕]孟子住在墓地的旁边对孟子有影响 — her note: 恐怕usually does not take Subj. except 我
  her past correction: 就自己觉得[-我]不想我的儿子在这个地方长大
  her past correction: 有一个妈妈和[他的→她的]儿子

[I62] 因为她恐怕儿子会【成为】跟他们很像   correction: 成为 → 变得   strength: error
  checker's note: 变得 is needed before an adjective phrase such as 很像.
  rule card (incorrect_story_information, Content): Use the story’s established facts when retelling it. Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this changes a story fact; the story says <fact>.  Her terms: wrong information, problematic in coherence
  her past correction: 她有一个很小的[孩子→儿子]
  her past correction: 有一个妈妈和他的儿子[+住在一起]
  her past correction: 有一个妈妈和[他的→她的]儿子

[I63] 她告诉【了】孟子：他们不是朋友   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: no 了 after the speaking verb 告诉
  rule card (no_le_speaking_word, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): A speaking word that introduces quoted speech normally uses no particle, not 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <speaking word> introduces quoted speech, so use no 了.  Her terms: no了for speaking word introducing quoted speech, no 了for speaking word, no了for speaking word
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧不是跟朋友玩 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 孟子一直跟他的朋友⟦去了⟧墓地祭拜 — her note: no了for routine/habit
  her past correction: 但是孟子一直哭[-了] — her note: it’s not about “completion”, no了

items.explanation: 住 for a completed duration in the story takes 了 (了completed).
搬家 is completed in the story, so it takes sentence-final 了 (了completed).
古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。
老是 is redundant because 常常 already expresses this repeated meaning.
Here the structure needs a verb meaning “to worry,” so use 担心. 恐怕 usually does not take a subject like 她 here.
变得 is needed before an adjective phrase such as 很像. 成为 is used before a noun or identity.
告诉 introduces quoted speech, so use no 了 for the speaking word.
